daily.next: keep the refits' spread on time splits

gate.id: time_decision_gate_v5 (v1's, unchanged; the daily arm alone)
gate.chosen: the decision is chosen on every seed (an operating point; no refusal)
gate.time_split: every run's data stage split by time (the strategy recorded per run)
gate.capacity: on every seed that acted, the holdout's actions never exceed its capacity (a share of its rows with one row's rounding; or the day by day slots the record states), and the holdout was read once
gate.coverage: among the seeds that chose to act (at least 20), the realised value per customer lies inside the choice's 90% prediction interval on at least 80% of them
gate.centre: each seed's z = (realised - the interval's centre) / (its half-width / 1.645); |mean z| <= 1.645 / sqrt(N)
gate.width: the 90% chi-squared interval of the root mean square of z contains 1 (neither too narrow nor too wide)
gate.inconclusive: fewer than 20 seeds acting: no verdict on the interval
gate.next: a pass: keep the refits' spread on time splits (each refit's latest-fold AUC beside the fold model's says whether weaker refits widened it); still too narrow (the width's interval above 1) with misses on both sides: out-of-bag refits on every fold's rows, each row scored only by refits whose resample left it out (never a refit scoring rows it was fitted on); too wide (the width's interval below 1): refit on subsamples without repeats; coverage below 80% with the width passing: pool v4's seeds with v5's same-method readings (no refits) and read v5's refit seeds apart; a centre off at the spread measured (routing only): above 0, models of the final size; below 0, correct the optimism of choosing the model
gate.paired: each run also keeps the interval drawn from every fold and the latest fold's interval without refits (v4's), on the same rows and seed, with their z: reported beside the gate, never gated
gate.refits_used: the gate reads only the seeds whose interval used the refits (the method says so); a seed without them is named and left out, never read as a refit seed

pooled_with_v4_daily.method: the latest fold's interval without refits (v4's), on v4's and v5's seeds
